## 1. ROCm bootstrap (mirrors CUDA bootstrap) — Stream 12

### `_bootstrap_rocm_via_amd_apt_repo(stream, arch) -> bool` (9417–9492)
Installs ROCm from AMD's official apt repo (`repo.radeon.com/rocm/apt/<ver>`).
- Bails if `apt-get` absent (9424). Picks target version via
  `_target_rocm_version_for_arch(arch)` (9427, defined at 8978); returns False
  for non-HIP arch (target `(0,0)`, 9428).
- Downloads GPG key via wget then curl fallback (9443–9450); `apt-key add` (9455).
- **Notable correctness detail (9457–9474):** reads the distro CODENAME from
  `/etc/os-release` (`VERSION_CODENAME=`) instead of the literal "ubuntu",
  because AMD's apt layout is keyed by codename (jammy/focal/noble/bookworm).
  Bails if codename undeterminable (9471).
- Writes `/etc/apt/sources.list.d/rocm.list` (9476), `apt-get update`, then
  installs `rocm-dev hip-dev` (9483–9485). Returns True on success.
- Catches CalledProcessError/Timeout/FileNotFound/OSError → logs FAILED,
  returns False (9489–9492).

### `_bootstrap_rocm_via_apt_stock(stream, arch) -> bool` (9495–9516)
Ubuntu stock `rocm-dev rocm-libs hipcc` fallback when AMD repo unreachable.
Returns False on any subprocess error.

### `_bootstrap_rocm_via_dnf(stream, arch) -> bool` (9519–9532)
Fedora/RHEL/Rocky/Alma — `dnf install rocm-hip-devel`.

### `_bootstrap_rocm_via_zypper(stream, arch) -> bool` (9535–9550)
openSUSE/SLES — `zypper --non-interactive install rocm-hip-devel`.

### `bootstrap_rocm_toolkit(stream=None, arch="gfx942") -> bool` (9553–9599)
Universal ROCm bootstrap. Short-circuits True if `hipcc` already on PATH (9563).
Tries the four methods in priority order (amd-apt, apt-stock, dnf, zypper;
9566–9571). Each wrapped in try/except → `_debug_swallow` (9577). Returns True
only when a method returns ok AND `hipcc` is on PATH afterward (9583). On total
failure prints a manual-install recipe (apt/dnf/zypper/pacman + docs URL) and
returns False (9587–9599).

### `_preflight_toolchain(arch, spec=None) -> List[str]` (9713–10003)
Returns human-readable `[preflight]` diagnostic lines; the build proceeds
regardless (this only surfaces missing deps early). Two-arg form (with `spec`)
adds the flag-probe pass; one-arg form preserves historical behaviour

  - **hip** (9793–9803): hipcc path, ROCM_PATH/ROCM_HOME, WARNING if hipcc
    missing.
  - **pallas** (9804–9813): imports jax, reports version, WARNING + pip recipe
    on failure.
- Universal checks for `ninja`, `g++` on PATH (9816–9821).
- **Per-arch PASS/FAIL judgment** (9823–9887): explicit one-line judgment per
  vendor (cuda via `_probe_nvcc_version`, hip via `_probe_hipcc_version`,
  pallas via parsed `jax.__version__`). On FAIL sets `fail_info` tuple

- **Stream β.2 suggestion block** (9889–9938): when judgment FAILed emits an
  actionable `[preflight] suggestion:` naming how to install/upgrade AND the
  highest-capability arch the current toolchain CAN target via
  `_highest_compatible_arch_for_version(vendor_key, have or (0,))` (9923,
  defined at 12610). Wrapped in try/except so a malformed ARCH_TABLE entry
  never crashes preflight.
- **Agent-F2 dry-run flag-probe** (9940–10002): only runs when (a) spec passed,
  (b) judgment PASS, (c) `spec.validate_flags` True, (d) `_FLAG_PROBE_DISABLED`

  try/excepted (advisory).

  - **NOTE (consistency, not a bug):** the judgment-passed check at 9950 greps
    `lines` for `f"arch={arch}"` AND `"PASS"`. The preflight WARNING line for

### `_resolve_path(spec, raw) -> Path` (10344–10356)
Stream A. Absolute paths returned as-is; relative anchored at `REPO_ROOT`
(resolved if it exists, else the un-resolved join).

### Module data
- `_AUTO_DISCOVER_EXTS` (10363–10367): vendor→compilable extensions

- `_AUTO_DISCOVER_PRUNE` (10372–10376): frozenset of dirs never swept

### `_auto_discover_sources(root, vendor, report=None) -> List[Path]` (10379–10401)
Mandate Tier-1 zero-config "find everything compilable" NVCC-parity fallback.
`rglob("*")`, prunes by path parts, filters by extension, returns sorted-unique.

### `_owns_extension_module_tu(path) -> bool` (10411–10451)
True if `path` is a standalone-JIT TU that must NOT be linked into a shared
`_ops` module — it defines its own `PYBIND11_MODULE(TORCH_EXTENSION_NAME …)`.
- Name rule: `*_selftest.cu` or `_overlay` in name → True (10433).
- Content check: reads text for `PYBIND11_MODULE(TORCH_EXTENSION_NAME`
  (10446–10447), **mtime-memoized** via `_OWNS_EXT_MODULE_CACHE`
  (10408, 10442–10450) to avoid re-reading ~30 cell sources per
  `_resolve_sources` call (~16 ms/call). Mirrors `setup.py._collect`'s AOT
  filter. This is the megakernel cell-TU exclusion (e.g.
  `mega_decoder_real_adamw_tc.cu`).

### `_tu_emits_pyinit_module(path) -> bool` (10471–10491)
True if a TU defines any `PYBIND11_MODULE(` (PyInit export baked at compile
time → must always be recompiled per-variant, never object-reused; reusing it
breaks dlopen with `PyInit_<new_name>` mismatch). Conservative: read error →
True (force recompile). mtime-memoized via `_TU_EMITS_PYINIT_CACHE` (10468).
- **NOTE:** `_tu_emits_pyinit_module` is NOT called anywhere within this slice;
  it is consumed by the incremental-build planner (elsewhere in the file). Its
  docstring describes the planner contract. Not dead — cross-slice consumer.

### `_resolve_sources(spec) -> List[Path]` (10494–10573)
Resolves the per-build source file list.
- pallas vendor → `[]` (10510–10511).
- Backend dir: `spec.source_roots[entry.vendor]` if set (with arch-subdir
  smart-append at 10520–10522), else `REPO_ROOT/csrc/backends/<entry.subdir>`.
- Bindings: `source_roots["bindings"]` or `REPO_ROOT/csrc/bindings`, globs
  `*.cpp` (10527–10533).
- Launchers via `entry.launcher_glob`, models via `entry.model_glob` under
  `backend/models` (10534–10541).
- **Fused L3 megakernel cell TUs** (10542–10562): globs
  `csrc/fused/<arch_subdir>/*.<ext>`, EXCLUDING any TU where
  `_owns_extension_module_tu(p)` (drops `*_selftest.cu` and the
  PYBIND-owning `mega_*_real_adamw_tc.cu` cells). This is the
  production L3-TC megakernel source set and restores AOT/JIT parity
  (comment cites the `mega_vit_supergrok2` undefined-symbol bug at 10546).
- Returns `bindings + launchers + models + fused` when non-empty (10563–10565);
  else Mandate Tier-1 auto-discover fallback over `REPO_ROOT` (or configured
  root) via `_auto_discover_sources` (10566–10573).

### `_build_macros(spec) -> List[str]` (10576–10620)
Emits `-D<PREFIX>OPTIMIZER_<NAME>=1 -D<PREFIX>MODEL_<NAME>=1 -D<arch_macro>=1
-D<verbose_macro>=1` plus `spec.extra_macros`.

...)`. Vendor-agnostic despite the name; HIP gets hipcc flags, pallas gets `[]`.

`validate_flags` defaults False so a missing-compiler probe on the install host
never silently drops canonical flags.

pallas → `[]`; else `LDFLAGS_BASE`. Trace-aware.
